subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay local image media from unmentioned requireMention group messages into a later mentioned turn, and under what retention, visibility, and local-path constraints?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes how unmentioned group media is retained and later exposed to agent/model context, which is a privacy and security boundary rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve bounded history media
options.body: Use the shared HistoryEntry.media contract for local images only, with hard retention/media limits, sender/group visibility checks, and no prompt-facing raw local-path leakage.

options.title: Keep text-only history
options.body: Leave unmentioned group media out of later agent turns and document that requireMention group history is text-only unless the current turn or reply carries media.

options.title: Make it explicit opt-in
options.body: Add or reuse an explicit operator policy such as ingest/visibility to permit retained unmentioned media only in configured groups or topics.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded history media
recommendation.body: Use the shared HistoryEntry.media contract for local images only, with hard retention/media limits, sender/group visibility checks, and no prompt-facing raw local-path leakage.
